data.title: 黑馆晴奈 · 顶层套房的白金丝绸晨袍
data.description: 基沃托斯高空顶层豪华套房内，落地窗外繁星闪烁。晴奈身穿一件极为考究的纯白真丝长浴袍斜靠在天鹅绒长榻上，领口微敞露出精致优雅的锁骨与雪白香肩。身侧的黑色蝙蝠形翼随呼吸微微收拢，她优雅地晃动着水晶杯中的顶级红酒，红宝石美眸微敛，向你投来品味极致佳肴般的从容而危险的迷人笑意。
data.action: reclining on velvet daybed in luxury penthouse, white silk bathrobe slightly open at collar, a single black demon wing folded behind, holding crystal wine glass, sophisticated alluring gaze
data.location: luxury high-rise penthouse suite overlooking neon metropolis
data.lighting: ambient city skyline glow paired with warm soft interior chandeliers
data.mood: decadent gourmet luxury, commanding aristocratic seduction
data.promptProse: Lounging on a plush daybed in a luxury penthouse overlooking the night skyline, Kurodate Haruna wears a lavish white silk bathrobe gently open at the neck. Her single black wing folds gracefully as she swirls wine with an enigmatic, seductive smile.
data.animaCaption: Haruna lounging in a white silk robe with a single black wing in a penthouse suite, holding a wine glass.
